metadata.description: Evidence-anchored code review for Claude Code, backed by the crAgent CLI.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a diff, branch, or pull request and report evidence-anchored findings ranked by blast radius. Every finding cites a line the diff changed; findings outside the diff are dropped rather than downgraded; 'no findings' is a valid answer. Escalates to the codereview CLI for large diffs, cross-file symbol resolution, inline PR comments, and CI gating.
